mapper.select: SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id WHERE e.id_card = #{idCard}
SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id WHERE e.name = #{name} AND e.phone = #{phone} ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id WHERE e.elder_no = #{elderNo}
SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM elder WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM elder WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT e.*, r.room_no FROM elder e LEFT JOIN room r ON e.room_id = r.id
AND e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND e.id_card LIKE CONCAT('%', #{idCard}, '%')
AND e.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND e.care_level = #{careLevel}
AND e.status = #{status}
ORDER BY e.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO elder (elder_no, name, gender, birth_date, age, id_card, phone, address, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_relation, health_status, care_level, status, check_in_date, room_id, bed_no, photo, remark) VALUES (#{elderNo}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthDate}, #{age}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{contactRelation}, #{healthStatus}, #{careLevel}, #{status}, #{checkInDate}, #{roomId}, #{bedNo}, #{photo}, #{remark})
